notes.title: Steam Store Page is Live!
notes.content: [h1]Steam Store Page![/h1][h2]Also this is out first announcement here.[/h2][p]Well, now there's no going back. We have a live Steam store page. The last thing we need to do is to actually publish our game (and finish it before publishing). For everyone reading this - have a great day![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45694834/685e605633e84a7b6f29be7c71d366f72eaa6f45.png"][/img][/p]
